We are seeking an Instructional Design Manager who will lead the instructional design team (including instructional designers and instructional technologists) to produce high-quality online courses and instructional assets delivered using advanced learning technologies. The manager will provide leadership in designing, developing and supporting online instruction, evaluating the effectiveness of that instruction, and planning for improvement that utilizes emerging best practices and innovations.

This position leads the Johns Hopkins School of Nursing's instructional design team, which partners with faculty and subject matter experts to design, develop, and continuously improve courses and learning experiences across the school's educational offerings. Reporting to the Director of Instructional Design, the Instructional Design Manager serves as the school's lead instructional design liaison to its programs and initiatives

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

Management and Supervision

  • Hire and supervise instructional designers, instructional technologists and other part-time members of the instructional design team.
  • Provide leadership to the instructional design team to produce pedagogically sound web-based courses by modeling effective instructional design, communicating with team members regarding required and completed tasks, outlining project plans, and providing status reports.
  • Build a high functioning team that is highly collaborative with other departments to ensure that dependent processes between departments function optimally and that the student experience in online courses is of a high-quality befitting our nationally ranked programs.
  • Develop instructional technologies project costs for grant and other related activities.
  • Monitor and manage risks to achieve goals and minimize negative impacts on course development and other instructional activities.

Instructional Design and Evaluation Leadership

  • Collaborate with the Associate Dean for Teaching and Learning and other members of the Academic Team to formulate support and evaluation strategies for online programs and courses.
  • Design production procedures to enable timely, efficient, consistent, and quality course development.
  • Provide educational programs designed to enhance the pedagogical expertise of faculty teaching in all programs offered by the school.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of online instructional approaches used within the school’s courses and develop plans for continuous quality improvement with faculty and the instructional team.
  • Provide solutions to instructional design related challenges using strong negotiation and problem-solving skills.
  • Apply Instructional Design project management best practices to lead team members through course development cycles.
  • Produce reports regarding online courses for distribution to school and university administrators, including but not limited to course enrollments, evaluations, and schedules.
  • Ensure that online courses, degree programs, and the delivery of distance learning are incompliance with university, state and federal regulations, guidelines and policies.

Instructional Design

  • In addition to serving as the manager for the team, serves as the lead instructional design liaison for one or more academic programs within the school.
  • Assist faculty in selection, use, design, and evaluation of web-based instructional strategies and technology.
  • Use the latest tools and technologies for online course development.
  • Assist faculty and instructional design team to use templates as a guideline for developing courses and modules.
  • Working with Information Technology Services, provides documentation and training resources to students and faculty in the use of instructional technologies used to support online instruction.
  • Assist with the writing and execution of grants to support the development of online courses or modules.
  • Research current and upcoming technologies and delivery modalities to guide growth and relevance of the instructional design team.
  • Other duties as assigned.

In addition to the duties described above

  • Serve as the lead instructional design liaison to SON academic programs and coordinate design priorities across programs with program leadership and faculty.
  • Lead course quality assurance using Quality Matters standards, including guiding the team and faculty through course reviews and improvement plans.
  • Lead design and development of courses, including establishing and maintaining SON course templates and standards for consistency across programs.
  • Turn strategy into operational procedures and workflows for the team.
  • Support university and school-level planning, assessment, and evaluation processes with data and reporting on online course development and quality.
  • Support strategic initiatives related to online learning quality, accessibility, learning analytics, faculty development, and continuous improvement of digital learning environments.


Minimum Qualifications
  • Master’s Degree in Instructional Design, Instructional Technology, Education, or related field.
  • Five years related experience including,
    • Supervisory experience and management skills.
    • Experience in instructional design and development with emphasis on designing both fully online and hybrid online academic courses.
    • Experience integrating technology into online instruction.
  • Additional education may substitute for required experience and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with academic course design, project management, and Storyline or other course authoring tools strongly preferred
  • Record of publications and/or presentations related to instructional design, education, learning technology or other related fields.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems (preferably Blackboard).
  • Three or more years of experience managing a team of instructional designers through multiple concurrent course development projects.

Technical Qualifications & Specialized Certifications

  • Should have membership/direct affiliation with professional associations and organizations that support future thinking around distance education.

Technical Skills & Expected Level of Proficiency

  • ADA Compliance - Advanced
  • Adult Learning Principles - Advanced
  • Educational Technologies - Advanced
  • Instructional Strategies - Advanced
  • Learning Management Systems - Advanced
  • Learning Theory - Advanced
  • Process Improvement - Advanced
  • Project Management - Advanced

The core technical skills listed are most essential; additional technical skills may be required based on specific division or department needs.

**Additional Information**:

  • Cover Letter (Preferred): Applicants are encouraged to attach a cover letter describing their interest in the position and how their qualifications align with the role.

  • Travel Requirement: Although this position is remote, occasional travel to the Baltimore campus is required for meetings and events.

  • Work Schedule: The position requires availability to work Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time.

  • Curriculum development.
  • Learning objective development.

  • Scenario-based learning design.
  • Assessment and evaluation development.
  • Technical writing and editing.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving.
  • Organization and time management.
  • Written and verbal communication.
  • Collaboration with stakeholders.Adaptability and continuous learning.

  • Experience supporting Department of Defense or Navy training programs.

Senior Instructional Designer

Red Nucleus is seeking a Senior Instructional Designer to join our L&D team, with expertise in designing and developing engaging instructor-led and virtual workshop experiences. This individual will partner with clients, stakeholders, and subject matter experts to create learning solutions that drive knowledge, skill development, and behavior change.

About Red Nucleus

Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives.
We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry.

Within our L&D team, we work with life sciences companies of all sizes, from those bringing their first product to market to the largest multinational firms. This role will primarily service clients in the oncology space, supporting sales reps, HCPs, MSLs, and other commercial roles.

About This Role

The Senior Instructional Designer role leads the design and writing of interactive, engaging, and creative learning solutions for life sciences industry professionals, across a number of modalities including live and virtual workshops.

This individual will translate client goals, objectives, and strategy into effective learning experiences for target learners. Every day is different and can range from performing curriculum
analyses and developing measurement strategies to designing specific deliverables that leverage blended approaches.

This position does not require original research of medical content but may use content written by a Medical Writer or client to create a new learning asset.

Specifically, this role will:

  • Design and develop engaging, effective instructor-led and virtual workshop materials, including facilitator guides, participant guides, job aids, quick reference guides, learning activities, simulations, and assessments
  • Lead instructional design discussions and reviews with clients and project teams to align learning solutions with business objectives
  • Develop interactive learning strategies that incorporate adult learning principles, application exercises, case studies, and facilitated discussions
  • Deliver and facilitate Train-the-Trainer sessions to prepare facilitators for successful workshop delivery
  • Support business development efforts through participation in proposals, pitches, and learning strategy discussions
  • Review and revise training materials created by others for instructional quality, learner engagement, and educational effectiveness

Requirements

  • Undergraduate or graduate degree in education, instructional design, organizational development, or a related field; or equivalent experience
  • Demonstrated experience in needs analysis, instructional design, curriculum development, learning measurement, and adult learning methodologies
  • Experience designing live and virtual instructor-led workshops and learning experiences
  • Ability to translate complex content into impactful learning experiences
  • Comfortable with AI tools, MS Office, and virtual meeting platforms
  • Exceptional verbal, written, presentation, and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced client environment
  • Strong collaboration, consulting, and stakeholder management skills
  • Knowledge of and experience within the life sciences industry, such as
    pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and/or medical device training

Red Nucleus is an equal opportunity employer. If you're interested in joining the Red Nucleus family, please submit your resume, cover letter, and salary requirements.

About Us

InStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes. We are doing this by combining research-backed clinical care and innovative technology to eliminate the major problems with care today: difficulty finding providers, months of waiting to be seen, arduous onboarding processes, and inconsistent use of evidence-based therapies and outcomes tracking. Our vision is to become the nation’s most trusted provider of pediatric anxiety and OCD care.

TeamInStride Health: Our Core Values

  • Give Heart: We lead with heart, treating patients and their families the way we want our loved ones to be treated.
  • Work Smart: We find smarter ways to solve hard problems and fix the broken mental health system by leveraging technology, diversity of thought, and innovation.
  • Have Humility: We leave our egos at the door, empowering our team to collaborate, celebrate diversity, and adopt a growth mindset.
  • Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role

We are looking for an Instructional Designer to design, build, and manage learning initiatives for our community of providers, including psychiatrists, therapists, and exposure coaches. As a key member of our Learning and Development team, you will partner with clinical leaders and subject matter experts to turn complex behavioral health protocols into engaging, practical training that strengthens the care our providers deliver to kids, teens, and families. The ideal candidate brings a background in online course creation and project management. This is a fully remote position.

Responsibilities:

Needs Assessment & Instructional Design

  • Conduct front-end needs analyses with clinical leadership to diagnose performance gaps and define measurable, performance-based learning objectives.
  • Apply adult learning theory and instructional design methodologies (e.g., ADDIE, SAM, Backward Design) to structure modular asynchronous and synchronous training paths.
  • Partner closely with clinical subject matter experts (SMEs) to translate complex behavioral health protocols into digestible, scenario-based learning experiences.

Content Development & Multimedia Production

  • Design and develop interactive e-learning modules, job aids, and knowledge checks using Articulate 360 (Storyline and Rise).
  • Script, record, and edit multimedia elements, including video walkthroughs, audio voiceovers, screencasts, and graphic assets, using tools such as Camtasia.
  • Use generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, AI voiceover platforms) responsibly to accelerate storyboarding, draft scenario scripts, build assessment items, and streamline authoring workflows.
  • Stay current on emerging technologies and trends in digital learning.

Measurement, Quality Assurance & Iteration

  • Build assessments that evaluate learner comprehension, retention, and clinical application.
  • Conduct rigorous quality assurance reviews of AI-assisted drafts and finalized modules to confirm clinical accuracy, tone, instructional integrity, and technical functionality before deployment.
  • Gather post-training analytics and learner feedback to continuously refine and improve curriculum assets.

Project Management

  • Deliver work against defined project timelines, share regular progress updates with cross-functional partners, and keep project tracking tools (e.g., ClickUp) current in real time.

What You Need to Succeed in the Role

  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Instructional Design, Instructional Technology, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of professional experience in instructional design and digital course development, ideally for specialized, technical, or clinical adult audiences.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in rapid e-learning authoring tools (specifically Articulate 360) and video/audio editing software (e.g., TechSmith Camtasia, Audacity, or Adobe Creative Cloud).
  • Solid foundation in adult learning theory, instructional design models, and assessment design (e.g., Bloom's Taxonomy, Kirkpatrick Evaluation Model).
  • Practical experience using generative AI tools to accelerate content ideation, drafting, and multimedia production while maintaining strict editorial and factual oversight.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Clear, effective verbal and written communication across remote, multidisciplinary teams.
  • Ability to work well both independently and as part of a collaborative, cross-functional team in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

Als instructional designer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het omzetten van bestaande kennis naar educatieve en boeiende e-learning modules die de inhoud duidelijk en effectief overbrengen aan ons publiek.

Functieomschrijving:

  • Ontwikkelen van e-learning modules in overeenstemming met de doelstellingen van het project en de vereisten van de klant.

  • Samenwerken met het productieteam om de inhoud van de video's te begrijpen en te vertalen naar een e-learning concept.

  • Onderzoeken van de doelgroep om de inhoud van de modules op een aantrekkelijke manier te presenteren.

  • Werken aan meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd en de deadlines bijhouden.

  • Aanpassen en bewerken van de modules na feedback van de klant en het productieteam.

Functie-eisen:

  • Ervaring met het bouwen van e-learning in moderne web-based tools zoals Easygenerator of Articulate Rise.

  • Ervaring met het editen van video’s in Premiere Pro of een vergelijkbare applicatie.

  • In staat om goede, pakkende en heldere teksten te schrijven.

  • Vloeiend in zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal, gepsroken en geschreven.

  • Oog voor kwaliteit: de behoefte om pixel-perfect op te leveren.

  • Teamspeler en in staat om effectief te communiceren en te werken met anderen.

  • Creatief en in staat om nieuwe ideeën en concepten te bedenken.

  • Goede organisatorische vaardigheden en in staat om meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd te beheren.

Loopbaan:

Je begint bij ons meteen met leren. De eerste dagen ga je trainingen volgen die wij voor onze klanten hebben gemaakt. Het zijn interessante trainingen met bedrijfskundige onderwerpen, waar je veel van kunt opsteken.

Dan gaan we je laten zien hoe wij scripts schrijven, video’s editen en cursussen inrichten. Onder begeleiding van jouw mentor - een ervaren e-learning expert - ga je al snel aan de slag om waardevolle producten te maken voor onze klanten. Je blijft je hele loopbaan dagelijks leren: Of het nu gaat om e-learning of om de producten van onze klanten waar de trainingen over gaan.

Van jou wordt verwacht dat je meewerkt aan het verbeteren van de content die wij aanbieden en aan het promoten van onze diensten aan potentiële nieuwe klanten. Wij verwachten dat je tijdens jouw loopbaan vakliteratuur leest en cursussen volgt om jouw kennis up to date te houden.

Verloop van de sollicitatieprocedure

Wij publiceren meerdere vacatures, en op elke vacature kun je je inschrijven. We verwachten van jou een CV en een portfolio. Je mag een korte toelichting toevoegen, maar wel zelf geschreven. Tip: Omdat het een creatieve functie betreft, kijken we zowel naar de inhoud als naar het design van jouw CV. Heb je ervaring in het maken van video’s en/of animaties? Stuur dan in jouw brief ook wat links mee naar het werk dat je hebt gemaakt.

De deadline voor het insturen van jouw sollicitatie is 1 juni 2025. Na deze datum zullen wij de profielen gaan bekijken en kiezen wij 5 kandidaten uit voor een gesprek.

Ben jij creatief, leg je graag dingen aan anderen uit en wil je vanuit huis werken? Maxcademy is een internationaal e-learning bedrijf met roots in Nederland. We hebben een geweldige kans voor een professional om ons team te versterken!

Onze klanten zijn heel divers: van multinationals tot gemeentes. Daarom komen er bij ons ook veel interessante onderwerpen voorbij in de trainingen die wij schrijven. Dit zijn wat voorbeelden van cursussen die we onlangs hebben geschreven voor onze klanten:

  • Hoe kun je jouw bedrijf circulair maken?

  • Hoe wekt een boer groene energie op?

  • Wat is een ERP systeem, hoe implementeer je deze bij een groot productiebedrijf?

  • Hoe richt je je bedrijfsprocessen efficiënt in?

  • Welke enzymen komen in melk voor, en welke functies hebben deze in het menselijk lichaam?

Zoals je ziet zijn onze onderwerpen dus heel divers. Daarom zijn er bij onze projecten altijd experts betrokken. Deze experts helpen onze instructional designers met het vinden van de inhoud. Jij moet hen helpen om dit op te schrijven en samen met de rest van het team te visualiseren. Het is belangrijk dat je je inleest op het onderwerp en het minstens even goed begrijpt als de cursist die de training gaat volgen.
